rationale: The assistant gave sensible, front-only steps that fit the evidence: unplug first, clean the sieve and sump, then run a glass-of-water test. It hedged appropriately on pump versus float, suggested an engineer if the test fails, and recommended no part. The last two turns mostly repeated the same test request, and the pump-listening advice was of little use since the customer said they wouldn't know what to listen for. The customer never ran the test, so the case stayed unresolved.
